walkthrough_label: Patient S2-B - differential diagnosis / diagnostic diversion: it may NOT be appendicitis (ectopic pregnancy)
reason_answer: I have bad pain and feel dizzy.

presentation.summary: Ms Sadia, 24, has lower-right pain, shoulder-tip pain and feels dizzy. Her last period was 7 weeks ago and the urine pregnancy test is positive.

history.answer: Pain in the lower right tummy, and a pain at the tip of my shoulder. I feel dizzy.
Some spotting yesterday; no fever; no urinary symptoms.
No anaesthetic problems in the family.
My last period was seven weeks ago.

observations.note: Fast heart and lowish BP: possible internal bleeding. NEWS2 recomputed.

examination.finding: Tender in the lower tummy, worse on the right; no rebound at present.

results.comment: Pregnant (about 7 weeks): ectopic must be excluded
Low: she may be bleeding inside

previous.when: booked at her GP 6 months ago

scores.name: NEWS2
scores.note: HR 112 (2) + BP 98 (2); recomputed from the table

problems.label: Possible ruptured ectopic pregnancy with internal bleeding
problems.why: Positive pregnancy test plus pain, shoulder-tip pain, fast heart, lowish BP and low Hb: NICE NG126 says exclude ectopic the same day.
expected_actions: Gynaecology now; keep nil by mouth

problems.label: Pregnancy status positive: it changes everything
problems.why: If the pregnancy test is never done it is a hard safety failure.
expected_actions: Do the urine pregnancy test before any scan or drug decision

decisions.prompt: Positive pregnancy test, shoulder-tip pain, HR 112, BP 98/60, Hb 104. What now?

options.text: Stop the appendicitis pathway: emergency call, two large drips, crossmatch blood, gynaecology now, nil by mouth
options.consequence: Matches the book and NICE NG126.

options.text: Continue the appendicitis work-up and send for CT
options.consequence: Ectopic until proven otherwise; avoid CT and delay.

correct: Recognise shoulder-tip pain and shock signs
Emergency call, two drips, crossmatch, gynaecology, nil by mouth

incorrect.shows: The debrief records a hard safety failure
incorrect.recovery: Do the test now; stop and escalate

missed: Not asking about the last period

debrief.related: Pain, shoulder-tip pain, tachycardia, low BP, low Hb
debrief.trigger_escalation: A positive test with pain, or shoulder-tip pain
debrief.remember: Always test for pregnancy in women of reproductive age with tummy pain

asa.why: Pregnant with suspected ectopic pregnancy and dizzy: pregnancy is ASA 2, and the risk of bleeding makes ASA 3 defensible; the E is for emergency.
